acceptance: All six families (environment, observation, semantic, operation, presentation, version) and common types are declared in one IDL with stable typed IDs, required and optional fields, bounds and explicit unknown values; generated bindings equal the committed files.

positive.fixture: 10 valid fixtures decode and re-encode byte-identically

negative.fixture: 79 invalid documents fail closed with the expected code and path

security_and_source_permissions: Contracts carry no credentials; documents declare required scopes and authorized contexts, and source-account permissions stay separate from VSF caller authentication.
performance_memory_storage: Generated Rust 4240 lines, TS 3128, Go 7017; vsf_wasm.wasm grew from 1,005,067 to 1,402,563 bytes before trimming.
known_limitations: WASM size growth of about 397 KB is untrimmed and left to B18
